liquidity.title: XOR estimate
liquidity.description: We check liquidity and fees automatically for the DAI amount you plan to use.
liquidity.allowed: This estimate meets the price-impact limit and leaves XOR after estimated swap and burn fees. Rates and fees can change.
liquidity.blocked: The price impact exceeds 5%. Do not fund this amount for this route. Wait for better liquidity or use existing XOR.
liquidity.unavailable: We could not check SORA mainnet. Reconnect; the estimate will retry automatically.
liquidity.expired: This estimate expired. It will refresh before the next review.
liquidity.feeReserve: Estimated swap and marked burn fees: {fees} XOR. Conservative amount left to burn: {burnable} XOR.
liquidity.feesUnavailable: Waiting for current swap and burn fees from SORA mainnet.
liquidity.feesInsufficient: This amount would not leave XOR to burn after the swap and burn fees. Increase the DAI amount and check again; it must also stay within the 5% price-impact limit.
liquidity.ready: About {xor} XOR available to burn after fees

conversion.tonRoute: Convert USDT on TON to ETH on Ethereum mainnet, then convert part of the ETH to DAI. Keep the rest for Ethereum network fees.
conversion.nativeTon: Starting with native TON? Swap TON to USDT on TON first. Keep TON for transaction fees.
conversion.tonMainnet: Connect a TON mainnet account to continue.
conversion.gas: Keep ETH for conversion and bridge network fees. Do not convert your entire ETH balance.
conversion.bridgeReserve: ETH to keep for the later bridge (estimate)
conversion.bridgeReserveNote: This ETH stays in your wallet for the later DAI approval and bridge. The check includes a gas margin and is repeated before conversion; future network fees can still change.
conversion.feeNote: Native currency sent includes any native input and attached provider charges. Listed provider fees may be included in the input or output. Wallet network fees are additional; review them before signing.
conversion.expired: This quote expired. Wait for updated terms before reviewing it again.
conversion.tonLiquidity: This DAI plan is checked separately. The TON transfer does not guarantee a DAI or XOR amount.
conversion.providerStep: This conversion currently requires the provider’s app. Select the same networks, tokens, amount, and Ethereum recipient there, then review its current quote.
conversion.submitted: Transaction submitted. Wait for confirmation and verify the receiving wallet balance before continuing.
conversion.continueEthereum: I have ETH on Ethereum — convert to DAI
conversion.haveDai: Already have DAI on Ethereum? Continue to the bridge review below.

errors.wallet: The wallet connection or network change was not completed. Try again when ready.
errors.noRoute: The provider has no route for this amount right now. No transaction was requested.
errors.quote: The conversion quote could not be verified. Check the wallet network and retry.
errors.transaction: The conversion was not confirmed. Check your wallet and transaction history before retrying.
errors.refresh: The quote expired during wallet review. Wait for the updated quote, then review again. Any confirmed approval remains on Ethereum.
errors.gas: Keep more ETH for the conversion and later bridge network fees, or lower the conversion amount.
errors.walletChanged: The wallet account or network changed. Get a new quote for the account you intend to use.

conversion.nativeTonHelp: Starting with TON instead of USDT?
conversion.budgetEstimated: This suggested amount keeps ETH for conversion and bridge fees. We check the final costs again before wallet review.
